reviews.expected_title: Ep 872: AI Cost Control 101: Why Your Chatbot Bill Is Becoming a Board-Level Problem (Start Here Series Vol 31)
reviews.summary: Everyday AI discusses how repeated agent actions, tool use and model choices can affect AI spending. Its published topic list and chapters cover automation-loop costs, model mixtures and approaches to monitoring and managing usage; this selection treats those as discussion topics, not verified savings or current vendor-pricing guidance.
reviews.why_it_matters: Gives teams a spending-governance lens to use alongside technical model selection, agent adoption and role-based learning. Readers can use the episode to frame questions about task budgets and usage visibility before approving broader automation.
reviews.audience_fit: Knowledge workers and nontechnical agent owners responsible for practical AI adoption and spending oversight.
reviews.novelty_assessment: Episode 872, its exact distribution identity and its current agent-spending focus are not in the reviewed production history. Earlier TWIML tokenomics and Everyday AI open-source coverage share the broad cost theme but are different episodes and treatments. This is a new selection, not an alias-based repeat.
reviews.editorial_limitation: Reviewed publisher description and chapters only, not audio. The show's claims about subscription changes, specific products and cost-saving effectiveness were not independently verified and are not repeated as facts.
